title: Composition with security-auth-magic-link: when both applied, the magic-link mint surface refuses submit without a valid Turnstile token
description: When security-auth-magic-link and edge-cloudflare-turnstile are both applied, the magic-link mint surface reads through the Turnstile guard: a mint submit without a valid Turnstile response is refused with 400 before the mint fires. Composition uses the TAC-3603 hook.
rationale: Ratified in the Cloudflare round 6 spec (2026-09-06 section 5.5). Ships as v1.0.0 of edge-cloudflare-turnstile.
